instruction: Locate the scores page for the 2021 NFL Wild Card playoff round.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the 2021 Wild Card (post1) playoff scores. Similar to original task which targeted post4 (Super Bowl), but for a different playoff round and year. Same URL structure pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree, which is the right state to verify navigation to the NFL scores page
Metric function 'is_expected_active_tab' correctly compares the active URL against the expected URL using compare_urls utility
Expected URL 'https://www.nfl.com/scores/2021/post1' is semantically correct - 'post1' corresponds to Wild Card playoff round in NFL URL structure
Complete coverage: instruction asks to locate the scores page, evaluator verifies by checking if active tab URL matches expected scores page URL
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL → metric compares URL → expected value matches instruction requirement
Edge cases handled: metric returns 0.0 if active_tab_info is empty or None
No postconfig needed since URL verification happens in the active browser state
